name: deepseek-code-agent
description: Explicit-only local DeepSeek Harness (DSH) delegation with concurrent teams and a separate legacy OpenCode/Luna lane.

interface.shortDescription: Explicit DSH delegation with concurrent teams and persistent sessions.
interface.longDescription: When explicitly selected, runs coding, review, testing and browser tasks in persistent local DeepSeek Harness sessions. Supports global and per-team concurrency, dependency handoffs, peer messages, corrections and current-Chrome control. The older OpenCode ds_* lane also requires explicit selection.
defaultPrompt: Delegate bounded implementation to local DSH with DeepSeek Flash and max reasoning, then review the result.
Use DSH to investigate and fix this repo, including tests, then report changed files and checks.
Use the legacy OpenCode ds_* lane only because I explicitly asked for it.
